note: Derived-store declarations (one-fact-one-home). Created with PR #5187's registration cure: the room projection is a read-time derivation that persists nothing, declared because its module names carry the projection marker.

entries.sourceOfTruth: The room's stored state as served by readRoomSnapshot (server/snapshot-window.mjs): the viewer-filtered, redacted, windowed snapshot. The projection module persists nothing; there is no stored copy of the slice.
entries.mechanism: Derived per request, in memory: projectRoomSnapshot cuts the requested classes from the shared windowed snapshot at read time, so a slice cannot drift from its source. Conformance is pinned by tests/room-projection.test.js (only-requested-classes with named omissions; summary carries counts and no bodies).

entries.sourceOfTruth: The same shared windowed snapshot (readRoomSnapshot in server/snapshot-window.mjs), reached through readRoomProjection in server/room-projection.mjs. The route module stores nothing.
entries.mechanism: No stored derivation: the handler validates the fields parameter (whole-refusal on unknown, duplicated, or missing fields) and returns the per-request slice produced from the live snapshot. Nothing is cached or persisted, so there is no copy to drift.
